description: This file defines the QuerySerializer class responsible for serializing AWS query protocol requests into HTTP requests. It constructs request payloads based on commands, endpoints, and API metadata, and returns PSR-7 Request objects.

classes.name: QuerySerializer
classes.description: Serializes AWS query protocol requests into HTTP requests, handling endpoint configuration and request body construction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the QuerySerializer with the specified API, endpoint, and optional parameter builder.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes an AWS command into an HTTP request with appropriate headers and body, suitable for the AWS query protocol.
